description: This file defines the TransactionQueue class, which manages transaction processing, including commit, abort, restore, and storage operations within Orleans transactions. It handles different commit roles, manages transaction states, and coordinates storage and confirmation workers.

classes.name: TransactionQueue`1
classes.description: Manages transaction lifecycle including commit, abort, restore, and storage operations, supporting concurrency control and transaction state management.

classes.name: PreparedMessages
classes.description: Holds the count and status of prepared messages received ahead of time for a specific timestamp.

methods.name: EnqueueCommit
methods.description: Enqueues a transaction record for processing, handling different commit roles and preparing storage actions.

methods.name: NotifyOfPrepared
methods.description: Handles notification that a transaction has been prepared, updating internal state or storing the message if received early.

methods.name: NotifyOfPrepare
methods.description: Handles notification to prepare a transaction, validating locks and updating timestamps and roles.

methods.name: NotifyOfAbort
methods.description: Handles abort notifications, notifying remote participants and completing transaction promises.

methods.name: NotifyOfPing
methods.description: Handles ping messages to check transaction liveness, triggering cancellation if unknown.

methods.name: NotifyOfConfirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation of a transaction, marking it as committed and batching responses.

methods.name: NotifyOfCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a transaction, aborting and cleaning up the commit queue.

methods.name: NotifyOfRestore
methods.description: Restores transaction state from storage during activation or recovery.

methods.name: GetMostRecentState
methods.description: Retrieves the latest committed or in-progress transaction state and sequence number.

methods.name: BatchableOperationsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of batchable operations at the end of the commit queue.

methods.name: StorageWork
methods.description: Performs storage operations, including batching, persistence, and recovery, with error handling.

methods.name: AbortAndRestore
methods.description: Initiates abort and restore procedures after errors.

methods.name: Bail
methods.description: Performs cleanup and deactivation after failures, aborting transactions and restoring state.

methods.name: CheckProgressOfCommitQueue
methods.description: Monitors and manages the progress and timeouts of transactions in the commit queue.

methods.name: CollectEventsForBatch
methods.description: Collects transaction events into a batch for storage or response.

methods.name: OnLocalCommit
methods.description: Handles local commit logic, including storage and notification.
